BiblicalUsage: hâdâh means to stretch forth the hand. In Isaiah 11:8, the text says "and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hâdâh I do not force more than it gives: to stretch forth the hand.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
